text.en:
1. (1) This order may be cited as the Price Control and Anti -Profiteering
(Determination of Maximum Price) (No. 7) Order 2025.

 (2) This Order has effect for the period from 23 December 2025
to 27 December 2025.

Maximum producer price

2. The maximum producer price for the price -controlled goods specified
in column (1) of the First Schedule for the State of Sabah, the State of Sarawak  and
the Federal Territory of Labuan is determined according to the areas and districts as
specified in column (2).

Maximum wholesale price

3. The maximum wholesale price for the price -controlled goods specified
in column (1) of the Second Schedule for the States in Peninsular Malaysia,
the State of Sabah,  the State of Sarawak and the Federal Territory of Labuan is
determined according to the areas and districts as specified in column (2).

Maximum retail price

4. The maximum retail price for the price -controlled goods specified in column (1)
of the Third Schedule for the States in Peninsular Malaysia, the State of Sabah,
the State of Sarawak and the Federal Territory of Labuan is determined according to the
areas and districts as specified in column (2).
